description: AI-DLC Human Receipt and Review Freeze, metadata-only Hook Audit and health, read-only context injection, actor-independent Tool scope guard, deterministic Sensors, and bounded Stage Agent result validation.

hooks.command: sh -c 'root=$PWD; while [ "$root" != "/" ]; do if [ -f "$root/.codex/distribution-manifest.json" ] && [ -x "$root/.codex/tools/aidlc" ]; then exec "$root/.codex/tools/aidlc" hook record "$root" --harness codex; fi; root=$(dirname "$root"); done; exit 1'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$root = (Get-Location).Path; while ($true) { $manifest = Join-Path $root '.codex\distribution-manifest.json'; $tool = Join-Path $root '.codex\tools\aidlc.exe'; if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $manifest -PathType Leaf) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tool -PathType Leaf)) { & $tool hook record $root --harness codex; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $parent = Split-Path -Parent $root; if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($parent) -or $parent -eq $root) { exit 1 }; $root = $parent }"
